summary: What each meter and instrument measures, then how to test receivers, repair boards, install equipment and track down faults.

blocks.title: Meters
items: DMM (digital multimeter): its 1/2 digit is a leading 0 or 1, giving partial extended accuracy on the lower part of the range.
Analog movement: current twists a coil, swinging the needle.

items.name: Half-scale voltage
items.means: Half scale takes half the current.
items.example: 50 µA, 2,000 Ω movement: 25 µA × 2,000 Ω = 0.05 V

items.name: Analog wattmeter error
items.means: Fixed at every reading, so only the upper 1/3 is truly calibrated.
items.example: At a 20 W reading, ±5 W is 25%

blocks.title: Oscilloscope
items: Maximum frequency response: set by the vertical amplifier.
Accuracy and stability: limited by sweep oscillator quality and deflection amplifier bandwidth.
10:1 divider probe decreases circuit loading; multiply the reading by 10.
Measures voltage, current with a resistor, and phase difference; not the velocity of light with an LED.

blocks.title: Measuring radios
items: Modulation-acceptance bandwidth test: finds a receiver's effective bandwidth. Set RF 6 dB above the 12 dB SINAD point, then raise deviation until SINAD falls back to 12 dB.
FM voice deviation: 5.0 kHz maximum on a normal wideband channel; 2.5 kHz is narrowband.
P25 (Project 25): a scanner needs P25 decoding.
CDMA (code division multiple access): RF power on an analog power meter isn't accurate.

blocks.title: Repair bench
items: Wrist strap for soldering or CMOS: less than 100,000 Ω, for the exam.
Plated-through holes: clear with a vacuum device.
Hot gas bonder: non-contact melting of solder.
Thermal stripper: ideal for removing insulation.
Wire ties: flush-cut diagonal pliers, and cut flush.
Board repair: most important is safety glasses.

blocks.title: Installation
items: 25 pair cable: 6th pair is Red/Blue, Blue/Red.
100-pair binders: blue, orange, green (51–75), brown.
Vehicle: cables must not interfere with normal operation.
Tower: UV ruins white or translucent tie wraps.
Rack: plumb to just inside the bubble.
SSB tuner to backstay: GTO-15 high-voltage cable.

blocks.title: Troubleshooting
items: 150 W SSB, steady 75 W keyed: a defect is transmitting the carrier.
Elevator tachometer: .01 µF capacitor across the motor/tachometer leads.
Programming: laptop computer, or infra-red without a wire.
Software-defined transceiver: built-in self-test.
Marine DSC: activate with a registered 9-digit MMSI. Verify GPS: latitude and longitude on the display.

items.def: signal plus noise and distortion, compared with noise and distortion alone. The meter: AF voltmeter in dB plus a 1000 Hz bandstop filter, for quieting tests.
standing wave ratio; low means a good match.
time-domain reflectometer: pulse generator plus oscilloscope.

blocks.title: Exam traps
items: 0.10 V is full scale, not half.
Field time base: rubidium, not cesium beam.
Counters measure; standards produce.
Scope: time domain. Analyzer: frequency domain; horizontal is frequency, vertical amplitude.
Sensitivity isn't 10 dB of SINAD, or 10 or 25 dB of quieting.
